# Executive Office

`admin.model.executive_office` · model · parent `—`

> A chief-of-staff or executive-assistant function organised around one principal or a small leadership team. Everything is prioritised by proximity to that person, and the scarce resource being administered is their attention rather than a process queue.

|  |  |

| typical_cycle_days | 1 |
| committee_size | 1 approver — the principal |
| decision_style | principal-centric; the EA holds delegated authority by convention rather than by policy |
